question: Can the current canonical background masters validly test for a PC-style physical edge/margin check-bit channel?

consensus_master_geometry.purpose: common background-print field above serial, with foreground symbol masked
consensus_master_geometry.consequence: cannot test sticker-border, wrapper-edge, or physical margin marks

historical_846shee_geometry.purpose: preserve directly visible background artwork evidence after community assembly
historical_846shee_geometry.consequence: crop edges are assembly/artwork boundaries, not original sticker margins

existing_seam_metrics.interpretation: strongly validate canonical IAB/CDE/FGH artwork continuity
existing_seam_metrics.reason: seam continuity measures ordinary background artwork matching at assembly boundaries

conclusion: Current master products are suitable for artwork registration and seam continuity but are structurally incapable of testing a PC-style physical sticker edge/check-bit channel. That question requires original full-sticker photographs re-rectified with the physical perimeter retained.

next_valid_test.preprocessing: rectify full sticker quadrilateral, preserve a preregistered perimeter band and serial exclusion separately
required_outputs: candidate edge marks separated from ordinary artwork continuity
next_valid_test.fail_closed: if edge support or geometric registration is insufficient, record untestable rather than infer marks
